x: Pfenninger, Finneron, Melchior and Sutton have done much to help our Field Events along, and Vallance may become a first-class pole vaulter in due course.

In the Javelin, Powell (164ft. 1in.) and Melchior (148ft 0in.) took first and third positions. Pfenninger won the Weight Putt for us with a magnificent effort of 39ft. 6in., and also took second place in the Discus Throw (116ft. 5½in.) and fourth in the High Jump (5ft. 6in.).
We won the Weight Putt with Grassau and Melchior, also the Javelin with George Powell and, once again, Melchior, who, by the way, materially contributed to our total of points.
Melchior gained third place with 31ft. 4in. The High Jump saw Leigh and the Imperial College gaining the points; and in the Javelin, M.

Melchior, F.
Charlie Melchior did well to win the Javelin event in the "Waddilove Trophy" Competition at Birmingham—our only win—and so contributed in no small way towards the winning of the Bowl.

We had Charlie Melchior throwing for us, but with Blakeway and Klein entered for Achilles, our man appeared outclassed. Imagine our surprise when Melchior nonchalantly walked up to us and said he had won the Javelin.

Charlie Melchior once again obliged in the Javelin, and moreover is very consistent with his throwing. Our Field Events captain, Charlie Jones, showed an improvement in his long jumping by gaining second place in that event, being beaten by the Police Champion.
In the Field Events our big Irish Guardsman, Pat Ridge, won both the Weight and Discus with very creditable efforts. Charlie Melchior " obliged " once more in the Javelin Throw, and E.
Charlie Melchior and Ron Jeal finished first and second in the Javelin event, and the former has been throwing in consistent style throughout the season.
Charlie Melchior has again been our outstanding javelin thrower. His best efforts have been 177ft. 5ins. at Imber Court against the Police and 169ft. 10ins. against the N.F.S. at Chiswick.

This loss meant that the brunt of the Shot event fell upon Charlie Melchior. He has gained us useful points in all matches and did a personal best of 34 ft. 8 ins. in the match against the Police at Imber Court.
Charlie Melchior won the Javelin Throw and also gained third place in the Weight Putt. Charlie Jones won the Long Jump and is showing a big improvement in his jumping.
Bergvalds retained his Weight and Discus titles and Charlie Melchior once again won the Javelin Throw.
